brief:
A senior Hamas delegation led by Bassem Naim, head of the movement's Arab and Islamic relations office, held discussions with top Iranian officials on recent political and military developments regarding the Palestinian issue, Shehab Wire reported. The talks covered the latest situation on the ground and political progress related to Palestinian affairs. The delegation engaged with high-ranking Iranian counterparts in what marks a continuing pattern of regional coordination by the Palestinian resistance movement.

The visit underscores Hamas's efforts to maintain close ties with Iran as it navigates evolving circumstances affecting Palestinian territories. The discussions addressed both current conditions in the field and broader political dimensions of the Palestinian cause, reflecting the movement's strategy of consulting with key regional allies on strategy and developments.
